title: Rotate Array by K Steps
problem: Rotate an array of n elements to the right by k steps, where k is non-negative.
edge_cases: k is greater than array size
hints: Reverse the whole array, then reverse first k elements, then reverse the rest.
code:
def solution(nums, k):
    n = len(nums)
    if n == 0:
        return nums
    k %= n
    def reverse(l, r):
        while l < r:
            nums[l], nums[r] = nums[r], nums[l]
            l += 1
            r -= 1
    reverse(0, n - 1)
    reverse(0, k - 1)
    reverse(k, n - 1)
    return nums
